channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Monta Ellis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Monta Ellis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Monta Ellis
item.description:
#Mavs ownerMark Cuban:

“Monta (Ellis) is a good guy and we’d be better if we had him this year.”

Mark Cuban on Monta Ellis, Mar 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Cuban on why he did not re-sign Ellis:

“It wasn’t his age. It wasn’t the miles on the body, that type of thing. It was just a numbers game. The two years he was with us, it was great. … It was no disrespect to him as a player.”

Mark Cuban on Monta Ellis, Dec 17, 2015. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis:

“I have great respect for him because he helped us win 99 games in 2 years and we wouldn‚Äôt have come closer without him. We're really grateful for what he did for us and as always you‚Äôve got to game-plan your butt off to get ready to play him. He‚Äôs a real problem to deal with because of his quickness, his ability to get to the rim, his ability to make plays.”

Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis, Dec 16, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis
item.description:
#Mavericks coachRick Carlisle on the difficulty of replacing Monta Ellis:

“Very difficult. You can‚Äôt pull guys like this off the street.”

Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis, Dec 16, 2015. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rajon Rondo:

“I met one of my best friends I consider now in Monta Ellis. I wouldn’t have met Monta if I didn’t get traded there.”

Rajon Rondo on Monta Ellis, Jul 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Devin Harris on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Devin Harris on Monta Ellis opting out:

“It creates a pretty big hole. It gives us more cap space, but I don't know if that's good or bad. Depending on how we do in free agency, if we do lose him, it will be a big void to fill.”

Devin Harris on Monta Ellis, Jun 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis' All-Star chances:

“I’m disappointed for him. He’s very deserving, as was some other guys that missed it.”

Rick Carlisle on Monta Ellis, Jan 30, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rajon Rondo on meshing with Monta Ellis:

“He scored 38 points, so I didn't hold him back too much.”

Rajon Rondo on Monta Ellis, Dec 21, 2014. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Jennings said of Ellis' explosion.

“He's on a team where they need somebody to score. Dirk (Nowitzki) is not that scorer like he used to be. He still can do it, don't get me wrong. But he (Ellis) is in a situation kind of like he was in at Golden State, before Stephen Curry and all of them got there. So he's the main scorer and he's the guy.”

Brandon Jennings on Monta Ellis, Dec 6, 2013. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Monta Ellis
item.description:
.@Mark Cuban:

“If Monta [Ellis] is an elite playmaker like he has been, you know, he's a cornerstone piece.”

Mark Cuban on Monta Ellis, Oct 18, 2013. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Monta Ellis
item.description:
“At first I couldn't believe it. It was like, 'Wow, we're getting Monta Ellis.' The first thing I said was, 'It looks like we'll be running a lot more.' Just up-and-down buckets, a lot of fast breaks. That's when I got more excited.”

Brandon Jennings on Monta Ellis, Mar 14, 2012. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis, Kwame Brown, Ekpe Udoh
item.description:
Mark Jackson on the trade:

“We are grown-ups and it hurts, so we are not going to sugarcoat it. We talked about it, we laughed, we cried and then we understood the mission was still the same, and it was a great win for us. I can't comment on anything officially right now but those three guys (Monta Ellis, Ekpe Udoh, Kwame Brown) bought into the system from Day 1. I owe a lot to them. People questioned me as a first-time coach, but those guys bought in since Day 1.”

Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis, Kwame Brown, Ekpe Udoh, Mar 14, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis
item.description:
Sam Amico:Warriors coach Mark Jackson on G Monta Ellis (23.7 ppg):

“Tough, athletic, and some guys just have a gift. His is scoring the basketball.”

Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis, Jan 17, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rick Welts on Monta Ellis
item.description:
“When we were made aware of a consensual relationship between Mr. Ellis and the plaintiff, we did what an organization should do: We told both to stop promptly, directly and fairly,”

Rick Welts on Monta Ellis, Dec 22, 2011. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis
item.description:
The guard committed to taking fewer shots and giving his all on defense.

“When I opened the door to my hotel in Memphis and Monta Ellis was standing there, I knew he was the guy,”

Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis, Dec 13, 2011. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.
